from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Domain Coloring: Painting the Function", 
                          ["Domain coloring maps 4D to 2D.", 
                           "Colors represent phase of complex numbers.", 
                           "Brightness indicates the magnitude at points."])
        
        # Assets
        canvas = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/canvas.svg")
        palette = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/palette.svg")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Map 4D to 2D concept
        self.play(self.lecture_lines[0].animate.set_color(BLUE))
        self.place_at_grid(canvas, 'B2', scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(canvas))
        
        plane = ComplexPlane(x_range=[-2, 2], y_range=[-2, 2], axis_config={"include_numbers": False})
        self.place_at_grid(plane, 'C3', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(Create(plane))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Colors represent phase
        self.play(self.lecture_lines[1].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        self.place_at_grid(palette, 'E3', scale_factor=0.4)
        self.play(FadeIn(palette))
        
        # Create a visual representation of phase color wheel

        wheel.set_color_by_gradient(RED, YELLOW, GREEN, BLUE, PURPLE, RED)
        self.place_at_grid(wheel, 'E5', scale_factor=0.4)
        self.play(FadeIn(wheel))
        self.play(Rotate(wheel, angle=2*PI, run_time=2))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Brightness indicates magnitude
        self.play(self.lecture_lines[2].animate.set_color(GREEN))
        dot = Dot(color=WHITE)

        self.add(dot)
        self.play(dot.animate.scale(3), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(dot.animate.set_opacity(0.3), run_time=1.5)
